en.cmd.compare_desc: Pick two files and open them in a side-by-side diff
en.cmd.compare_with_desc: Diff the current file against another file you pick
en.cmd.pick_left_desc: Pick a different file for the left pane of the diff
en.cmd.pick_right_desc: Pick a different file for the right pane of the diff
en.cmd.swap_desc: Exchange the left and right files
en.cmd.refresh_desc: Recompute the diff from the current contents of both files
en.cmd.next_hunk_desc: Move to the next differing region
en.cmd.prev_hunk_desc: Move to the previous differing region
en.cmd.open_at_cursor_desc: Open the file of the focused pane at the cursor's line
en.title: *Diff: %{left} | %{right}*
en.error.no_file: No file in the current buffer to compare
en.error.same_file: Both sides are the same file
